text:
lee-oncall: seeing a barrage of 503s from apiserver in eu-west1 for the last 6m, also lots of etcd leader flips :eyes:
lee-oncall: provisioning jobs for gpu-pool-2 are failing with AttachVolume errors, probably why we see reconcile backlog
jordan: ack, I'm looking at controlplane graphs now. etdc_commit_latency spikes + apiserver client conn drops coincide with a NAT metric spike
lee-oncall: exact logs: `E0312 17:08:10.123 apiserver.go:432] 503 POST /api/v1/nodes/provision (attach): dial tcp 10.2.8.5:2379: connect: connection refused`
anika: helm release? any recent config change or routed traffic shift? :thinking_face:
lee-oncall: no config change in the last deploy window, but we had a k8s autoscaler bump in eu-west1 around 17:00 that triggered a large number of GPU attach flows
maria-sre: pushing graphs -> https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ctlplane/etcd-apiserver?orgId=1 : looks like etcd leader changed 4x in 5m, commit latency >200ms during spikes
sam-network: NAT gateway SNAT table for eu-west1 shows exhaustion around the same time, lots of ephemeral connections from kubelet/attach calls. SNAT% at 98% for a few mins
jordan: that explains connection refused to etcd endpoints if proxy paths are being dropped. can we temporarily route controlplane traffic through a different egress?
anika: can we scale NAT or set kubelet to reuse connections / reduce churn? longer term need to fix attach flow aggregation
lee-oncall: mitigation idea: taint gpu-pool-2 to stop new provisioning and then drain pending pods to other pools. that'll reduce attach churn. any objections?
maria-sre: +1 for stop provisioning. also enable fallback to local-attach path for critical jobs if available :thumbsup:
sam-network: scaling NAT now (adding 2x SNAT nodes), ETA ~5m. also opening firewall hole to allow direct controlplane egress to keep keepalives stable while this rolls
jordan: rolling NAT up. deploying small canary patch to kube-proxy to increase conn reuse timeout: `kubectl set env ds/kube-proxy -n kube-system PROXY_CONN_TTL=300` (will monitor)
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1123 controlplane-eu-west1-snat-exhaustion, severity P2
lee-oncall: after starting NAT scale, etcd leader flips subsided and apiserver 503s dropped. still seeing a small backlog in controller-manager (reconcile latency ~45s)
anika: controller-manager queue shows many Pending attach retries. suggest bump controller-manager workers down to reduce API fanout while backlog drains
jordan: applying `--controllers=*,bootstrapsigner` patch to reduce parallel reconcilers for now
maria-sre: can we also add a short-lived admission controller rate limit? just for attachments to avoid thundering herd on attach-controller
sam-network: NAT nodes are up, SNAT% back to 12%. looks safe. recommend keeping taint in place for 30m and then gradual untaint with rate limit on scheduler sidecar
lee-oncall: plan: 1) keep gpu-pool-2 cordoned 2) allow existing to finish, 3) monitor controller-manager backlog, 4) after 30m uncordon with rate limiter enabled. i'll own runbook and post updates
jordan: noted. will follow up with a postmortem and cost delta (extra NAT nodes add ~$0.12/hr each)
maria-sre: nice catch on SNAT being root cause. add to postmortem: consider long-term fixes: per-subnet NAT pools, connection reuse in attach controller, and prefetched volumes for GPU jobs
anika: agreed. also add metric alert for SNAT usage crossing 80% -> trigger autoscale earlier
lee-oncall: thanks all. leaving cordon in place for now. ping me if anything changes :eyes:
deploy-bot: rollback of k8s-provisioner v2.8.1 -> v2.8.0 scheduled in 10m as precaution (requested by @jordan)
lee-oncall: noted deploy rollback, won't uncordon until we validate controller queue shrinking
jordan: last check: apiserver 500/503 error rate down 92%, etcd leader stable for 12m, controller-manager queue length steadily falling
lee-oncall: closing thread when we confirm backlog cleared. good recovery team :clap:
